3. What is a single-line comment in Java?
A single-line comment is used to comment only one line. It begins with two forward slashes, //.

blocks.text:
// This is a single-line comment
System.out.println("Hello Java");

runs.text: Everything written after // on that line is ignored by the compiler.
4. What is a multi-line comment in Java?
A multi-line comment is used to comment multiple lines. It begins with /* and ends with */.
The compiler ignores all the content between /* and */.
5. What is a documentation comment in Java?
A documentation comment is used to provide information about a class, method, or program. It begins with /** and ends with */.
Documentation comments are commonly used with the Javadoc tool to generate documentation.

Java is called an object-oriented programming language because most programming tasks are performed using classes and objects.
Java provides classes for different purposes. For example, the Scanner class is used to create an object that accepts input from the keyboard.

13. How do you import the Scanner class?
The Scanner class can be imported using the import statement.
The import statement makes the Scanner class available for use in the current program.
14. Why do we import the Scanner class?
The Scanner class is already written and stored in the Java library. We do not need to create the Scanner class ourselves.
We import it into our program so that we can use it to create a Scanner object.
Without importing it, Java may show an error such as:
Scanner cannot be resolved to a type

A Scanner object can be created using the new keyword.

18. What is the purpose of the Scanner object?
The Scanner object reads input from the keyboard and returns the entered value to the program.

blocks.text:
Scanner scan = new Scanner(System.in);

int age = scan.nextInt();

runs.text: In this example, the Scanner object reads an integer from the user and stores it in the age variable.
